scope: Private fixed-rule historical diagnostics only; all six histories already examined, no training/prospective prediction or source promotion.
features: Reuse EVT-3 strictly-prior 60-observation volatility and volume baselines. Daily/gap z at least 3; volume ratio at least 3; prior 20-session trend / (prior daily volatility * sqrt(20)) at least 1 in absolute value. Combined rules fixed, both directions tested, no optimization.
episodes: First qualifying bar per pattern/instrument with 20-session cooldown; overlapping patterns/horizons are not independent trials. Cross-pattern totals are not sample sizes.
controls: Non-trigger strictly-prior volatility/trend control in preceding 126 sessions and at least 22 sessions earlier, chosen before outcomes with existing EVT-3 matcher; all missing outcomes retained.
timing: After complete bar only; next-session close entry, H later intervals; only examples and control outcomes matured strictly before assessment date. Historical receipt/current-vintage limitations preserved.

possible.tests: Direction-consistent mean/median price change; mean/median net long profit positive for UP, negative for defensive DOWN; positive median directional SPY excess (SPY self-comparison explicitly exempt, no alpha claim); median paired control difference supports direction; later examined slice agrees. High fees may remove Possible. No forced ratings.
possible.meaning: Exploratory historical hypothesis, not a current forecast or approved paper trade; DOWN is risk watch, never a synthetic short profit.

likely.validation: Reviewed, hash-pinned independent validation artifact registered in repository; genuinely new pre-outcome predictions after frozen training cutoff, audited independent episodes, primary point-in-time prices, permitted usage, positive net stressed-cost and benchmark/control robustness. Historical success rate alone never sufficient. No approved artifact exists.

ranking: Rating, complete evidence coverage and sample breadth first, adverse movement/cost fragility next, observed median movement last. Not predicted gain or optimized best rule.
source_evidence: Reuse 39 dated EVT-3 source entries and complete 18 issuer/FDA controls; price-first retrospective catalyst tags never become historical signal inputs. Missing/late/unknown clocks remain explicit.
historical_validation: All historical slices exploratory, including reference through 2019 and examined 2020-2026; 20-session boundary embargo. No genuinely untouched historical evaluation claimed.
